d: Aachary vishnugupt apne shishy chandragupt ko shiksha dene ke lie takshashila le jana chahte hai magar chandragupt ke mama unse 5 hazar karshapan mangte hain jo kisi shikshak ke lie bahut adhik rashi hai to kya hoga aage- kahan se chukaenge aachary vishnugupt 5 hazar karshapan dekhie is bhag men.
